propositions: Only P8 too-big blocks currently short-circuit plan review before LLM passes; P1/P5 DET-floor blocking findings do not prevent the full four-pass LLM review

The plan_review_precheck short-circuit branch should be widened to accept any DET-gate blocking finding, not just P8, reusing the partition_findings/finalize_verdict path to emit BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=False
A plan that fails a blocking DET-floor check (e.g., P1 missing Acceptance Criteria) should yield zero finder/LLM invocations and return a BLOCK verdict carrying all DET findings
The gate_dispatch outage path already handles all DET blocks (not just P8) in partition_findings, so no changes are needed there
Existing test test_p1_det_block_still_runs_llm_and_blocks asserts the old behavior (LLM runs despite P1 block) and must be inverted to assert zero finder calls and BLOCK verdict
